interpretive_limits: Requested/approved/contracted MW are distinct from energized metered load and from critical IT load. No cross-source nationwide total is calculated.
ERCOT monthly non-simultaneous max is the sum of individual monthly maxima; it is not an instantaneous coincident grid peak or energy average.
PJM workbook annual historical July peaks cover large-load adjustments; the report charts a separate monthly DC-only series. Do not call RTO!D19 data-center-only MW.
California CEC requested total includes 2,600 MW in Nevada. Table 1 stage rows differ from the printed total by 1 MW due to published rounding.

California CEC 67% ratio is peak demand relative to service-request capacity; 85-90% observed hourly factor uses observed peak demand as denominator. Do not multiply or compare them as the same ratio.
California CEC Form 1.1c forecast spreadsheet has a zero STATEWIDE Total row despite positive utility rows; its statewide cell is unusable.
Georgia PSC fact sheet says 9,985 MW certified new generation while its Dec2025 press release says 9,885 MW. Neither is delivered DC load.

NARUC roster/page census establishes state source discovery only. Local permit portals, state air permits, municipal electric utilities, and customer-confidential service agreements prevent this from being an exhaustive national project or metered-load census.
